name: YouGlish
description_short: Search any word or phrase and hear it spoken in dozens of real YouTube clips, filterable by accent — pronunciation and natural usage from authentic speech, not synthetic audio.
teacher_note: Good for settling a pronunciation question on the spot mid-lesson — search the word live and let the student hear several real speakers say it.
creator: YouGlish
internal_notes: Verified live: core search and accent filtering (US/UK/Australia/Canada/Ireland/Scotland/New Zealand) work with no login required. Optional sign-up/donation exists but doesn't gate core use. age_group/cefr_level/group_fit left unknown rather than guessed — a general-purpose lookup tool, not a leveled activity.
